description: Street Fighter Alpha 3 (CPS2, MAME sfa3). Player records are 0x400 apart from 0xFF8400. Health is a big-endian word; MAME read_u16 returns the number and the bank stores it little-endian. Full bar is 144 (0x90). Round clock is a byte at 0xFF8109 (90 at round start, 0 on menus).

P1_HEALTH.note: Player 1 health word at player base + 0x50. Full bar is 144.

P2_HEALTH.note: Player 2 health word at 0xFF8800 + 0x50. Full bar is 144.

ROUND_CLOCK.note: Round timer. 0x5A is 90 seconds. 0 outside a round, so a 0 health bar on the title screen is not a KO.

P1_GAUGE.note: Player 1 POWER gauge byte at base + 0x11F. 0x90 is MAX.

P2_GAUGE.note: Player 2 POWER gauge byte. 0x90 is MAX.
